y7ba013e1bca.add: - **Factors that raise an ecosystem's biodiversity:** high **productivity**, **intermediate disturbance** and greater **age** of the ecosystem; **fewer trophic levels** do not raise it.

ya8f714783e5.add: - **Insects** = about **half (~50%+)** of all recorded species on earth (over 70% of animal species).

y1b4a69093ee.add: - **Tropical rainforests** cover only ~7% of the land but hold about **half (50%)** of the world's species.

yd6633040160.add: - **Nalleru (*Cissus quadrangularis*, bone-setter / hadjod):** a traditional medicine for **bone health** – fracture healing (a productive/medicinal value).

y5fff1c4646f.add: - **Quadrat sampling:** 20 ha = 2,00,000 m²; 1% sampling intensity = 2,000 m²; 2,000 ÷ (20 × 20 = 400 m²) = **5 quadrats**.

y0663e0d6894.add: - **Sampling terms:** the population value of a characteristic = a **parameter**; the value from a sample = a **statistic**.

y10b95a927c5.add: - **Extinct vs alive:** dodo, **West African black rhino** (declared extinct 2011) and **Chinese river dolphin / baiji** (functionally extinct 2006) are gone; the **red panda** is Endangered but still alive (Eastern Himalaya).

yc3730a72973.add: - **Invasive species = second-biggest cause of biodiversity loss**, after habitat destruction; Parthenium is a classic case (A and R true, R explains A).

y619eda245d8.add: - **Campbell Bay NP (1992)** and Galathea NP are on **Great Nicobar, A&N Islands** (together the Great Nicobar BR core); Dachigam is in J&K, Gir in Gujarat, Guindy in Chennai.

ycdbea2f8037.add: - **Indian Rhino Vision 2020:** adopted 2005 by the **Assam government** (with the Bodoland Territorial Council) in partnership with **WWF-India and the International Rhino Foundation** – not launched by MoEFCC; target **3,000 wild rhinos** in 7 PAs of Assam by 2020, believed met.

y8d720876d77.add: - **Central Zoo Authority (CZA, 1992):** constituted under the **WPA 1972** (1991 amendment) to regulate zoos in India; NTCA came in 2006 (not 2010), and the 2022 amendment cut the schedules to **four**.

y598a9f54cf6.add: - **Vanam-Manam (AP, 2017):** target of **1 crore (10 million)** saplings across the State, aiming at **50% green cover by 2029**. The yearly targets changed: 2 crore in 2016, 25 crore in 2018-19.

y85e4e2f486c.add: - **Chipko's demand:** no forest-exploitation contracts to outsiders; **local communities should have effective control over natural resources like land, water and forests** (NCERT XII).

ye18e81c37d0.add: - **Warming and the monsoon:** more erratic rain – heavier spells, longer breaks, more floods and droughts – so the monsoon becomes more **devastating and unpredictable**.

yb271ef124ae.add: - **Policy measures:** cheaper, faster, better-connected **public transport** and rules for **pooling private vehicles** cut vehicle emissions; sound-proofing hospitals controls noise, not air pollution.

y75933aa8c53.add: - **Natural cleansing:** **rain** washes particles and soluble gases out of the air (wet deposition / scavenging), so it cleans a polluted atmosphere.

ya30ac6abac1.add: - **Indirect harm to forests:** dumped biomedical and e-waste **leaches toxic substances into soil and water**, damaging ecosystems and forcing land-use change (new dump sites, clearing), which adds to deforestation and biodiversity loss.

y24333e4e64e.add: - **ISFR 2015:** total forest carbon stock **7,044 million tonnes** (up ~103 Mt over ISFR 2013).

y594e1c53860.add: - **Firecracker safety:** **PESO** (Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation, Commerce and Industry Ministry) certifies firecrackers and enforces safety standards under the **Explosives Act, 1884**.

yb8b1557610e.add: - **Why vulnerability rises:** poverty, **inadequate access to resources**, **low awareness**, **blind faith in beliefs and customs**, unplanned growth. **Spread of irrigation** is not a cause, since it reduces drought risk.

y2b6c6114845.add: - **Biological warfare in history:** European colonisers spread **smallpox-laden blankets and kerchiefs** among Native Americans (Fort Pitt, 1763).

y672e0862cb1.add: - **Landslides** occur mostly in **hilly** (mountainous) areas: Himalaya, North-East, Western Ghats and the Nilgiris, where slopes are steep and rain is heavy.

y472e031c883.add: - **Aims of first aid (3 Ps):** **preserve life**, **prevent the condition from worsening**, **promote recovery** → "all the above".

ya166e620907.add: - **Natural factors** that make India disaster-prone: **extreme weather conditions** (monsoon variability, cyclones, heat), the young Himalayan geology and a long coastline.

y643873a79dd.add: - **Triage colours:** **Red** = immediate (life-threatening), **Yellow** = delayed (serious, not life-threatening), **Green** = minor (walking wounded), **Black** = dead or expectant (pain relief only until death).

y64f36ef3915.add: - **Hurricane/cyclone preparedness:** secure outdoor furniture, board up windows, keep a communication plan, move valuables to **higher ground**. Leaving them in a **low-lying area** is the least effective step.

y297834bb358.add: - **Monohybrid cross (Mendel):** pure tall (TT) × dwarf (tt) → **F1 100% tall** (Tt); F2 = 3 tall : 1 dwarf (75% tall).

yaa14d583d91.add: - **Sterilisation:** heat-sensitive fluids such as **serum**, vaccines and antibiotic solutions are sterilised by **membrane filtration**. Glassware is sterilised by hot air, culture media by **autoclaving** (121 °C, 15 psi).

y969cdf589d7.add: - **Integrated farming system (IFS):** crops + livestock + fish/poultry on one farm. Benefits: **higher profitability**, **use of by-products** and **recycling of farm waste** → "all of these".

y24e4bb12a05.add: - **eSoil** (Linköping University, Sweden, 2023): an electrically conductive growth substrate for hydroponics made of **cellulose** + the polymer PEDOT; stimulated barley seedlings grew ~50% more in 15 days.

y29a986e514f.add: - **Chikungunya drug research:** **IIT Roorkee** scientists (Prof. Shailly Tomar's group) found new antiviral drug candidates against the chikungunya virus; there is still no approved specific drug.

ya5cd55a7805.add: - **WHO definition of health (1948):** a state of complete **physical, mental and social well-being**, not merely the absence of disease; social equality and harmony support individual health.

yee88e9e03b4.add: - **Diagnosing microfilaria:** night blood thick smear and concentration methods (**micro-haematocrit / buffy coat**, Knott's, membrane filtration). **Lane's centrifugal flotation and Willis flotation** are stool tests for helminth eggs.

yc959c9e074c.add: - ***E. coli*** infection spreads mainly through **contaminated food** (undercooked meat, raw milk, unwashed produce) and water – the faeco-oral route.

y4217579c164.add: - **Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD):** Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis – chronic inflammation of the **gastrointestinal tract** (genetic, e.g. NOD2, and immune factors).

y850d808bd1e.add: - **Community transmission:** cases cannot be traced to travel or a known contact – an infected person, unaware of the infection, infects others in the community (beyond local or cluster spread).

y4e889813833.add: - **Projective personality tests** (ambiguous stimuli): **Rorschach inkblot test**, TAT. MMPI, EPPS and the Allport-Vernon-Lindzey study of values are self-report inventories.
